name: Weekend Plans
about: Friday-to-Sunday ideas across Dubai: rooftop nights, beach days, markets, museums and spontaneous road trips. Post yours.

stories.author: p06
stories.text: Friday night jazz on a Downtown rooftop. Bring a jacket, the breeze is lovely.

stories.author: p01
stories.text: Saturday brunch and a beach walk, sunscreen check done. Simple, perfect.

stories.author: p10
stories.text: Sunday sea swim at 6am, then coffee. Weekend reset complete.

posts.author: p06
posts.text: Friday night plan: rooftop jazz in Downtown, then a late dessert walk by the fountains. Who's joining? I'll bring the playlist and the good headphones for the walk.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Rooftop jazz plus dessert walk is my perfect Friday. Count me in, I'll bring the cake.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Yes! I'm in, Kwame. Bring the good playlist, I'll bring the friends who love jazz.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Downtown on a Friday is busy, what time should we meet? Need a plan for the team.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: After my long run I'm always hungry, so the dessert walk is my reward. In.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Which rooftop? The views at sunset are the best, please say the name.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: @anjali_rao the one with the live band near the old souk. Doors open at 8.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Coffee before the jazz, please, I'm a coffee guy and I need the energy.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Puppy is not allowed on rooftops, he's too excited. Next time with the walk.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Late dessert walk after a jazz night, the perfect combo. I'll be there after my swim.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: Dessert walk by the fountains is my favourite Downtown evening. Bring a light jacket.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Dessert plan: the cardamom ice cream place near the fountains, then the cheesecake.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Cheesecake is non-negotiable. Yalla, the Friday crew is growing!

comments.author: p09
comments.text: We'll be a group of six, I think. Tell us the metro stop for the rooftop.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Metro to Burj Khalifa station, then a ten minute walk. Easy and no parking stress.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Metro is the smart choice for a Friday night in Downtown. No car, no problem.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: I'll pick up the group water bottles on the way. Dehydrated jazz fans are sad jazz fans.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Water and coffee, the two things needed for a long Friday. Good plan, Ravi.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Puppy sends his best wishes to the jazz crowd. He is sleeping on my feet right now.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: A night of music and fountains sounds like a great end to the work week.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: Good luck with the crowd. Let me know if the band plays something slow.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: They always play something slow at the end, it's their signature. Bring tissues.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Tissues are in my bag. Cake and tissues, a complete Friday kit.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: I'll bring a power bank for the phones. The photos at the fountains need battery.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: See you all at 8pm. Let's keep the group chat short and the music loud 🎶

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Jazz, fountains and friends. This is why I love this city. See you there.

posts.author: p01
posts.text: Saturday beach day plan: sunrise at Jumeirah, a swim, a shaded brunch on the sand, then a nap under an umbrella. Anyone want to join? Bring the good snacks.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Sunrise swim is the best way to start a Saturday. I'll bring the lifeguard energy.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: I'm in for the sunrise, but I'll cycle there. Shade stop at the midpoint please.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Brunch on the sand with cake is my dream. I'll bring a box of pastries.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Sunrise run then swim then brunch. The perfect three-part weekend, count me in.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Dogs are not allowed on the public beach, sadly. But the puppy will wave from the balcony.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Umbrella rental on the beach costs a bit, bring your own if you can. Saves money.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Coffee in a thermos for the sunrise, the perfect pairing with the sea breeze.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Sand, sea and snacks. Bring a speaker, but keep the volume low for the others.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Sunrise is at 5:50am, I'll be there with the group. Not sure I'll be awake, but I'll try.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Set two alarms, Hannah. The sea will wake you up when you arrive.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Bring a towel, sunscreen and a hat. The beach at 10am is a different beast.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: Sun cream reapplication every two hours, that's the rule from my swim coach.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Snacks: hummus, pita and fruit. Easy to carry, easy to share.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Coconut water on the beach is a must. Cold, sweet and very refreshing.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Keep the rubbish in a bag, please. The beach cleaners will love you for it.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Puppy's favourite beach activity is the rubbish bag. Please do not share the bag with him.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Coffee after the swim, from the thermos, the best cup of the week. Trust me.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Adding this to our team Saturday list. Thank you for the detailed plan, Sara.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Good plan. The sand brunch will be full of stories, bring the music.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Swim buddies wanted for the sunrise, the flags will be up. Stay in the zone.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Yes, the flags are up on the public beach. Safety first, friends.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: I'll be there at 5:45, bringing an extra towel for anyone who forgot one.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Extra towel plus cake plus coffee, the team has everything covered.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: See you at sunrise. Let's make the sea the start of a great weekend.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Thermos is ready. Coffee for the sunrise crew, and nobody is allowed to be late.

posts.author: p07
posts.text: Family-friendly Sunday idea: the Mirdif park with a picnic, a bike ride around the lake, and an ice cream stop. Low cost, big smiles. Anyone else doing this?

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Mirdif park is perfect for families and dogs. My puppy will love the picnic blanket.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Picnic with homemade cake is my Sunday ritual. I'll bring a lemon loaf.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Low cost and big smiles, that's the best kind of weekend. I'm in next week.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: Bike ride around the lake is the best part of the day. Helmet on, bell ringing.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Ice cream stop after the bike ride, the best end to a Sunday afternoon.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Coffee in the picnic basket, my family rule. The kids have juice, the parents have coffee.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Our team is new to Dubai parks, so this list is a big help. Thank you, Anjali.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Lake ride then a swim in the shallow pool if it's open. Family day, Omar style.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Early morning picnic before the heat is the way to go. Sunday at 7am is perfect.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: @ravi_menon yes, 7am is perfect for the picnic. Bring water and a hat.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Puppy's ice cream is a dog-safe frozen yoghurt. Ask the stall, they know the rules.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Frozen yoghurt for the puppy, a lovely treat. Good tip, Mariam.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Park is clean and well kept, the staff are friendly too. Good choice, Anjali.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: Helmets for the kids and a bell for the adults. The lake loop is safe and flat.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Shade is key, so choose the trees near the play area. The grass stays cool.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: My kids would love this. Maybe next Sunday we'll try it with the whole team.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: A team picnic at Mirdif, with coffee for everyone. A brilliant idea, Hannah.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Keep the water bottles, the heat is the enemy of all picnics, even the good ones.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Running around the lake first, then the picnic. A runner's family day, I love it.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Puppy approves of the picnic plan, he wants the sausage rolls and he knows it.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Sausage rolls are for the humans, puppy. Your treat is the frozen yoghurt.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Thanks, everyone. I'll post a photo of the picnic next Sunday, the kids are excited.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Yalla, family picnic in Mirdif. See you there, Anjali 🌳

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Our team picnic is on the calendar now. Thank you for the great idea, everyone.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: Good plan. Keep the lake loop clear for the bikes, please. Shared path, shared joy.

posts.author: p03
posts.text: Museum weekend: the new art gallery in Al Quoz has a free Saturday tour at 11am. Afterwards we can get lunch at the cafe next door. Who wants to come?

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Al Quoz gallery is a favourite of mine. The cafe next door has excellent coffee, yes.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Free tour plus lunch is a bargain weekend. I'll join with the playlist for the walk.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Art and lunch on a Saturday, perfect. Is the tour in English or Arabic?

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Tours in English, Arabic and sometimes French. Check the schedule on the website.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: I'll cycle there after the morning ride. The bike rack by the gallery is covered.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Art and a swim would be an odd combo, but I'll pass on the swim and join for lunch.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Museums are my favourite rainy-day weekend plan, even in Dubai. Count me in.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Puppy is not allowed in the gallery, but he'd love the murals outside. Sad but fair.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Art plus a run around Al Quoz after the tour. The murals are a great route.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Lunch at the cafe after the tour, I'll bring a dessert for the table.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Coffee after the tour is on me for the first ten people. Yusuf's rule for this weekend.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Free coffee and free tour, I'm definitely coming. The team will love it.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Thanks for the info, Layla. I'll be there at 10:45 to get a good spot.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Good spot for the tour is near the front, the guide speaks loudly and clearly.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Dubai's art scene is growing fast. Glad to see the community turn out for it.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: The gallery has a bike parking and a water fountain, a good place for cyclists.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Art lovers are the best company on a weekend. Looking forward to it.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Art and lunch, I've marked it on the calendar. A great way to spend Saturday.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Puppy's art review: the murals outside get five paws, the gallery gets maybe three.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Ha, the puppy critic is harsh but fair. See you all Saturday, bring your curiosity.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Looking forward to it, Layla. Thanks for organising the group.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Art, coffee and friends, my favourite weekend formula. See you there.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Let's do a photo walk after lunch, the murals are very photogenic.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Yes to the photo walk. I'll bring the camera and a snack for the group.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Enjoy the art, everyone. A good Saturday is one with a bit of culture and a lot of coffee.

posts.author: p09
posts.text: Spontaneous road trip idea: drive to Hatta on Saturday morning, a short hike, a lunch by the dam, then back before sunset. Who has a car and wants to share the fuel?

comments.author: p04
comments.text: I have a car and I'll drive. Leave at 6am to beat the heat and the traffic.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Hatta is beautiful in the early morning. I'll bring water, sunscreen and the good snacks.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: A hike in the morning is great, and a swim in the dam later if it's allowed. Check the rules.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Hatta trail is my favourite long run in the mountains. I'll bring the running shoes.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Road trip playlist ready. I'll bring the good music and the tangerines.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Lunch by the dam with a picnic blanket, pastries and coffee. My dream road trip.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Puppy can come if the hike is dog-friendly. Please check before we all get in the car.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Carry more water than you think you need. The mountains are hotter than the city.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Coffee before the drive, thermos ready. A good road trip begins with a good cup.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Thanks Tomasz! I'll split the fuel with you, and I'll bring the snacks for the car.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: Share the petrol and the playlist, that's the fair deal. See you at 6.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Mountain roads can be windy, so drive safely and take breaks. No rush at all.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Plan the route in advance and check the weather. Summer hikes need careful planning.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Sunrise in the mountains with a cold water and a run. My idea of a holy morning.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Yalla, road trip with the crew. Will the car have enough seats for the cooler box?

comments.author: p03
comments.text: I'll bring the cooler box and a few cake slices. There's always room for cake.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Sunset back in the city after the dam is a lovely finish. Plan the timing well.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Let's do a group check-in on Friday night to confirm the car list.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Puppy's answer is yes, but only with a seat belt and a bed in the back seat.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Coffee in the mountains, I'm already imagining the view and the aroma.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: Good, group chat check-in Friday at 9pm, I'll post the car plan there.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Confirmed for Saturday, I'll be the one with the snack bag. Thank you all.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Good luck with the trip, and have fun in the mountains. Yalla, road trip 🚗

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Pack a cooler with cold water, the road is long and the sun is strong.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Dates and a flask of coffee for the dam picnic, the classic road trip snacks.

posts.author: p02
posts.text: Weekend long run at Umm Suqeim beach at sunrise, eight kilometres, flat and beautiful. Anyone want a pace group? I'll be the chatty one at the back.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Chatty at the back is my favourite pace group. Count me in, with the swim after.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Umm Suqeim at sunrise is a special place. The sea is calm and the sky is pink.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: I'll join on the bike, and sweep the group at the back. Safety first.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Run then pancakes, the rule of the weekend. I'll bring the batter.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Puppy is a sprinter, not a long runner. He will join for the first two kilometres.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Eight kilometres on flat sand is a good target for a new runner. Going to try.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: After the run, the coffee stand by the beach is open. Bring cash, just in case.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Sunrise runs are the one thing I want to start doing. Maybe this is the day.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Hannah, you can do it. Start with the walk breaks and enjoy the views.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: @anjali_rao the route is flat, the sand is firm near the water, great for a steady pace.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Stay close to the water edge for firmer sand, and watch out for the lifeguard flags.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Music at the sunrise run is a great idea. Headphones on, volume low, and enjoy.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Pancakes after the run, and I'll bring a jar of honey for the group.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: Honey on pancakes after a long run is my favourite post-run treat, Layla. Respect.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: The puppy wants to know if pancakes are dog-safe. Don't let him near the honey.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Coffee and sunrise on the sand, the way to start a lovely weekend.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: I'll be the one with the thermos and the cups. Don't forget your cups.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Okay, I'm convinced. Setting two alarms and laying out the running shoes now.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Good energy, everyone. Sunrise run, see you at the beach entrance.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Yalla, a great weekend start. Stay hydrated, friends, the sun gets strong fast.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Thank you all, the pace group is growing. Let's make it a regular Saturday thing.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: A regular Saturday run club with pancakes, I'm very happy about this plan.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Pancakes forever. See you at sunrise, bring your appetite and your smile 🥞

comments.author: p04
comments.text: I'll bring the bike for the cool-down ride along the beach after the run.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Coffee cups for the beach runners, bring a few extra. Shared joy.

posts.author: p05
posts.text: Dog-friendly weekend escape idea: a drive to a quiet beach with a dog run, a shaded picnic area and a water fountain. Anyone know a spot that is open on Sundays?

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Umm Suqeim has a quiet corner on Sundays with a shaded area. Dogs are allowed in the early morning.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Lake park in JLT has a dog run, and it's open daily. Good for the morning run too.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Mushrif park has a shaded picnic area and a water fountain, the Sunday crowd is calm.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: A small beach with a dog run is rare in the city. Check the rules before going.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Picnic with a dog, cake, and a flask of coffee, the classic Sunday in the park.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Shaded picnic area is key for a puppy, he needs the cool grass and the water bowl.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Bring a collapsible bowl and a towel, dogs get hot faster than people in the sun.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Coffee shop with a dog bowl on the way is a nice stop for the drive home.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Our team dog is very social, and the picnic idea would be a hit with the office.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Thank you all. Mushrif on Sunday sounds like the easiest choice for the puppy.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Mushrif is a solid pick. Bring the puppy early, the afternoon is too hot for the paws.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Early morning dog run at Mushrif is my favourite for the sprint training. Join me.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Mushrif park meetup is also on the Pet Parents calendar, Mariam. See you there.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: The fountain at Mushrif is a bit slow, but the shade is worth it.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Puppy approves the picnic plan, the cake is for the humans, the biscuits are for him.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Puppy's weekend is planned better than mine. Good job, Mariam.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Dogs and coffee are a fine weekend pair, as long as the dog stays on water.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Adding this to my weekend list. Thanks for the ideas, everyone.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Good luck on the Sunday trip, Mariam. Send us the photos from the shade.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Keep the puppy cool, the sea breeze is only good in the mornings. Enjoy the day.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Enjoy the park and the run. The puppy is a natural athlete, I can tell.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: A perfect dog day, I'll be there with the cat's photos for comparison, lol.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Dog and cat photo comparison contest. Who will win, the puppy or the cat?

comments.author: p04
comments.text: The puppy wins by a tail wag, obviously. Yalla, have a great Sunday.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Thanks everyone, the puppy is already asleep, dreaming of Sunday 🐶

posts.author: p08
posts.text: Saturday morning coffee crawl: five roasters in five neighbourhoods, one cup each, and a map. Anyone want to try the crawl with me this weekend? Bring a notebook for scores.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Five cups before noon, my heart is already racing. But yes, I'm in with a notebook.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Pastry stop in the middle of the crawl, please. I'll bring the lemon tart as a bribe.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: A coffee crawl with a map and a notebook is very Kwame-approved. Count me in.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Five roasters is a lot of caffeine, Yusuf. Let's do three and a long lunch.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: I'll cycle between the stops. Smart route, short distances, very fun.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Coffee crawl after a swim is my kind of morning. I'll join the second stop.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Please keep the cups small, the crawl is about tasting, not drinking a full mug each time.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Coffee crawl plus a run in between, the perfect combo for a runner who loves espresso.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Puppy will stay home with the water bowl, but he wants a full report on the scores.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Small cups, yes. A coffee crawl is about curiosity, not caffeine overload. Good call.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Notebook scores for the lemon tart, too. Please don't forget the pastry category.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Hannah's scoring sheet is ready, I'll share it in the group. Acidity, body, sweetness.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: A scoring sheet is a must. I'll bring a pen, the mint for my tea, and a big appetite.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Let's name the best cup of the crawl, a trophy of sorts. Maybe a paper crown.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: A paper crown for the best cup, the most Dubai thing I've heard all week.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Keep the crawl to the morning, the coffee and the sea make the best pairing.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Yusuf, your map is a gift for the group. Thank you for planning it.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Map is great. Tag the cafes with the cycling access, runners need shade too.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Puppy gives the crawl ten paws for the idea, and zero for the coffee he can't have.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Pastry plus coffee plus friends, the best crawl the city has seen, I'm sure.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Final list is ready, I'll share it tonight. See you all at the first stop.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Coffee crawl confirmed, the first stop opens at 8am. Bring your curiosity.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Good luck with the crawl, Yusuf. Let the coffee guide the day ☕

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Yalla, a weekend of coffee and friendship. See you all on Saturday.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Coffee crawl, map and friends, the way to a happy Saturday. Let's go!

posts.author: p10
posts.text: Night swim with friends at the public beach, under the stars and the lights of the Marina towers. Not allowed everywhere, so only in the lit zone and with a buddy.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Night swim under the Marina lights sounds magical. Buddy system is a must, of course.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Please stay in the lit zone and check the flags, the sea at night can surprise you.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: Cycling to the beach for a night swim is my kind of weekend. Count me in next time.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Puppy watches from the balcony with a sad face, every time someone swims at night.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Night swim, then dessert at the beach cafe. The perfect late weekend, I'm sure.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Night swims are the best memories I have from this city. Please go safely, friends.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Keep your phone in a waterproof bag and tell someone where you are. Good habit.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Coffee after the night swim is a bold move, but I'll be the one with hot chocolate.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: We did this once with the team and it was the best team bonding we've ever had.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: @hannah_b team bonding in the sea is the best kind. Just keep the buddies close.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: Lights of the towers reflecting on the water, a view I'd never tire of. Thanks for sharing.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Night swim with the lights is one of the best Dubai experiences. Thanks for the tip.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Music on the beach at night? Please, the speakers should be off for the swimmers.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Night dog walk on the beach, no swimming, just the sea sounds. Puppy approves.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Dessert on the beach with the sea sounds, the lovely end to any evening.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Night swimmers are a special kind of people. Brave and happy, I like them.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: A safe night swim with a buddy and a lit zone, the rules are clear. Thank you Omar.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Hot chocolate on the sand, a good end to the swim. My team will love the idea.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Next team night swim is planned for the summer. Lifeguard coverage, of course.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Good to hear. Plan with the lifeguards, and let them know your group size.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: Pedal to the beach, swim, and pedal back under the stars. Yes.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: I'll try the night swim after the next night run. Double session, the brave way.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Puppy says good luck to the swimmers, from the balcony with a very loud bark.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Enjoy the night, stay safe, and let the stars do the rest. Yalla 🌊

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Lovely post, Omar. Dessert is on me for the first night swimmers who return.

posts.author: p07
posts.text: Weekend ideas for the rainy-season surprise: an indoor climbing gym, a board game cafe in Business Bay, and a cosy hotel tea. Dubai has more indoor fun than you think. Share yours!

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Board game cafe in Business Bay is a great shout. I'll bring the strategy games.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Indoor climbing gym is a fun workout, and the staff are very helpful for beginners.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: Hotel tea with a view is a treat, a great way to slow down on a Sunday.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Hotel afternoon tea with pastries, a Layla favourite. Count me in for the scones.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Puppy's indoor fun is the sofa and the tug toy. Simple, but he's very happy.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Board game cafe with good coffee is my dream. I'll bring my favourite card game.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Indoor pool and a sauna, if you need a rainy day that feels like a spa. Recommended.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Climbing gym after a run is a good cross training session. My legs were shaking, lol.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Board game night is the team's favourite. Maybe the next office event at the cafe.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: @hannah_b great idea. Board game night with a coffee menu, the perfect office party.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Indoor cinema and a bowl of popcorn is still my favourite rainy day plan.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Popcorn and cake at the cinema, bring both, the snack is the best part of a movie.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Indoor markets in the malls are good on hot days too. Pick a cool corner and wander.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: Malls are the summer version of the park. Cool air and window shopping.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Pet-friendly malls are a thing now, I'm told. Check the rules first.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: The coffee shops in the malls are often better than you'd expect. Give them a try.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Indoor pools are great for the heat. Fun, cool, and no sunburn, a very good plan.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Thanks for the ideas, Anjali. I'm trying the climbing gym this week.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: We'll do the board game cafe for the team on Friday. Thanks for the spot.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Board games and dessert, that's the Kwame winter plan too. Yalla.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Hotel tea on Sunday, I'll bring the scones. We'll make it a tradition.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Thank you all. Dubai's indoor fun is a lot more fun with friends. Enjoy the weekend 🎲

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Yes! Indoor fun with good people is the best kind. See you around the city.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Cosy and bright, your weekend ideas are a treat, Anjali. Stay cool everyone.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Puppy would love the indoor pet-friendly corner, if there's a mat for him.
